notes: Animated forecast screen: live weather background (soft sun glow, drifting clouds, rain, snow, stars, gentle lightning) that follows the current weather, a city swipe that follows your finger with the sky blending into the next city, cards that slide in on open, the hourly chart drawing itself, smooth expand/collapse of days with an arrow, and the temperature counting up after a refresh. New setting: Forecast screen → Live background. Animations stop when the screen is closed and respect the system "remove animations" setting.
